content.short: Genius Yield is a capital-efficient DeFi platform on Cardano featuring a DEX and AI-powered yield vaults.
content.description: Genius Yield is an all-in-one decentralized finance protocol designed to maximize capital efficiency on the Cardano blockchain. The platform features a sophisticated DEX utilizing Concentrated Liquidity Market Maker (CLMM) protocols and an AI-driven Smart Liquidity Vault that automates trading strategies to optimize yields. Governed by the $GENS token, the ecosystem also includes an educational Academy to help users navigate complex financial tools. By leveraging Cardano's EUTxO architecture, Genius Yield provides a secure and scalable environment for all DeFi participants.
